subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this iMessage DM sender repair merge only after canonical handle normalization and after-fix live proof, or may maintainers accept source-only identity-boundary risk?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the authorization subject and reply route, so accepting weak candidate comparison or source-only proof is a security and message-delivery judgment rather than a routine code-style choice.

options.title: Require canonical normalization and proof
options.body: Block merge until peer selection uses the channel's canonical handle normalization and the PR body shows redacted after-fix live iMessage proof.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Merge based on source review plus pre-fix incident evidence while maintainers own the remaining live-payload and identity-candidate uncertainty.

options.title: Pause for a narrower issue
options.body: If the author's current failure is a different root cause, pause or close this branch and track the remaining iMessage issue separately.

recommendation.title: Require canonical normalization and proof
recommendation.body: Block merge until peer selection uses the channel's canonical handle normalization and the PR body shows redacted after-fix live iMessage proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current conversation repair path and have recent iMessage monitor history directly adjacent to this branch.
